posts.title: Why your profile picture might suddenly look different
posts.description: Lots of players on Whisthub suddenly have a new profile picture, and that's no coincidence. The stock photos we used as default profile pictures kept failing to load, so they have been replaced by generated ones. This post explains what changed, who is affected and why.

posts.title: More tournaments, more fun: introducing Weekend Cups
posts.description: Tournaments are coming to the weekends! Weekend Cups use a new hybrid format, where three qualifying rounds without eliminations decide who goes through to the knockout stage, so you're no longer out after a single bad round. They also form a separate series next to the existing tournaments, with a champion of their own.

posts.title: Trull games will now end prematurely
posts.description: It's clear from the many emails that I get about the perceived frequency of trull on Whisthub that few people actually like them. While there is nothing that can be done about their frequency, from now on there is something else that should make trull games more bearable. This blog post explains what changes.
